mapper.sql: select creg_llave as key ,creg_comprobante as voucher ,creg_cuenta as account ,(select ccue_nombre from account.cuenta_cue where ccue_llave = creg_cuenta) as accountName ,(select ccue_codigo from account.cuenta_cue where ccue_llave = creg_cuenta) as accountCode ,creg_descripcion as note ,dreg_fecha as factDate ,mreg_positivo as positive ,mreg_negativo as negative ,mreg_valor as value ,dreg_creacionfecha as createdAt ,creg_creacionusuario as createdUser ,creg_creacionusuarionombre as createdUserName ,dreg_modificacionfecha as updatedAt ,creg_estado as state from account.registro_reg a
mapper.select: update account.registro_reg set dreg_modificacionfecha = now(), creg_comprobante = #{voucher}, creg_cuenta = #{account}, creg_descripcion = #{note}, dreg_fecha = #{factDate}, mreg_positivo = #{positive}, mreg_negativo = #{negative}, mreg_valor = #{value}, creg_estado =#{state}
